objective: Fill functional gaps for Hi-Fi D1-D3 including pH interlock, Emergency Stop, schedule conflict detection, and real-time command status.

acceptance.criterion: pH Up and pH Down pumps are interlocked so they cannot run simultaneously.
Emergency stop command turns off all hardware, sets FSM fault phase, and is supported across backend, firmware, and frontend UI.
acceptance.verification: Unit tests in control.rs, command_handler.rs, and EmergencyStopConfirmDialog.test.tsx

acceptance.criterion: Automation schedule conflict banner displays when active flows share equipment at identical cron schedules.
acceptance.verification: Unit tests in scheduleConflicts.test.ts and AutomationConflictBanner.test.tsx

acceptance.criterion: Command status pill and inline PWM/flow rate display on device control cards.
acceptance.verification: Unit tests in StatusPill.test.tsx and AdvancedDeviceControl.test.tsx
